title: ArchGuard-APR: Architecture-Constraint-Aware Multi-Agent Program Repair Using Repository Graphs and Execution Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.33853v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repository-level automated program repair must reason about more than a localized failing statement. A candidate change can satisfy a narrow test while violating dependency boundaries, modifying an unsafe path, or relying on context that omits relevant repository structure. ArchGuard-APR is an architecture-aware repair prototype that integrates deterministic repository analysis, immutable repository graphs, explicit architecture profiles, graph-guided context retrieval, role-based repair orchestration, patch-policy enforcement, isolated execution feedback, provider cost controls, and canonical source-free evidence.   We evaluate the implemented pipeline through an exploratory paired feasibility study, not a confirmatory effectiveness experiment. translated_title: ArchGuard-APR：基于仓库图谱与执行反馈的架构约束感知多智能体程序修复
translated_abstract: 仓库级自动化程序修复所需考量的远不止一处局部化的失败语句。一个候选变更可能在通过狭窄测试的同时违反依赖边界、修改不安全的路径，或依赖于遗漏了相关仓库结构的上下文。ArchGuard-APR 是一个架构感知的修复原型，它集成了确定性的仓库分析、不可变的仓库图谱、显式的架构配置、图谱引导的上下文检索、基于角色的修复编排、补丁策略执行、隔离的执行反馈、提供商成本控制以及规范的免源码证据。我们通过一项探索性的配对可行性研究（而非验证性的有效性实验）来评估所实现的流水线。原计划执行六次；其中四次完成，两次 black-4 条件在进入提供商阶段前因基础设施损耗而终止。在两个有效的配对任务中，基线条件与 ArchGuard 条件各自产……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: ArchGuard-APR 提出了一个架构约束感知的多智能体程序修复原型，通过不可变的仓库图谱、显式架构配置与隔离执行反馈来引导和约束补丁生成，使修复结果不仅通过测试，还不违反架构边界。
en_tdlr: ArchGuard-APR is an architecture-constraint-aware multi-agent program repair prototype that leverages immutable repository graphs, explicit architecture profiles, and isolated execution feedback to guide patch generation so that fixes pass tests without violating architectural boundaries.
